title: Reinventing Voting with Digital Identity, Trust and Anonymity

ms.promise:
We will use the first milestone to finalise the specifications. The outputs are:
・Assessing the Identus/Agent node system for managing DID and VCs
・Reviewing choices, validating capabilities, and defining minimal requirements (functional and nonfunctional) for a DID wallet as a browser extension 
・Defining all requirements (functional and nonfunctional) for a minimal Voting App, including for those roles: Admin, Designer, Voter, Viewer
・Reviewing choices for a voting App (App vs DApp) and establishing final choice
・Defining high level architecture for the chosen Voting App choice (App vs DApp), including what will be delivered as smart contract, and what will be delivered as more classic "Web2"

Each of those outputs will be documented (with documentation and/or video) in the GitHub repo (https://github.com/incubiq/vote_with_did).
ms.criteria:
・We have proof that Identus is fit for purpose for the DID/VC part
・We have clarity on the requirements for a DID wallet as a browser extension, and proof that it can be done 
・We have clarity of requirements, and high level design for the voting App/DApp
・All requirements and specifications are uploaded to GitHub
・There is no major blocking point to deliver the full solution

Note that the goal is to deliver a DApp but pending on further evaluations during this milestone, it could be a valid solution to limit the DApp to a small set of smart contracts and build the rest as a Web2 backend SaaS

ms.report:
Hello Reviewers, here is the M2 proof of achievement:
General explanation video of M2 tasks: A 10min video covering all our milestone outputs: https://youtu.be/Z-IB0SwvdSg 
Open-source code: In regards to the code, you can find it here: https://github.com/incubiq/vote_with_did/tree/main/crypto-wallet-ext ; it supports all the minimal requirements defined in the M2 acceptance criteria. 
a/ As explained in the video, I have finally opted to develop the entire solution end-to-end, as opposed to integrating other open-source solutions into my code, as the level of support I was going to receive was not compatible with my expectations. 
b/ the code in the github repo requires another backend module to access Identus, which I have mostl;y developed now, and will publish here as part of M3. Therefore, if you run this code alone at this stage, you will not get any DIDs or VCs as it will not connect to Identus without the additional backend.
What next: The little delay in delivery is partly due to having had to implement a/ and b/ at this early stage, and not have the ability to plug into other open source components. The setup of Identus (on AWS) was also a big job, although it does not show up much in the milestone, apart from having access to a real DID and real VCs. Those being mostly done now, I have good hopes that M3 will be delivered as per its original deadline, if not earlier.

Thank you for your valued contributing in reviewing this milestone.
Eric

ms.promise:
This Milestone is about the delivery of an Identity App which will act as the Trusted Issuer (and verifier) of Verifiable Credentials issued to users for the purpose of voting. This milestone also requires connecting the DID wallet and the Identity App, as well as improving some capabilities of the DID wallet.
Those outputs (code / capabilities / video proof) will be available in the Github repo:
・A working Identity App which plugs onto an Identus Agent Node and provides those capabilities:
・issue DIDs
・issue VCs
・verify VCs
・the DID wallet (delivered in M2) can now:
・connect to the Identity App
・prove (via signature) that its owner also owns other wallets
・request a VC issuance for "proof of voting power" (at first we may hardcode a random value, but ultimately it will contain the sum of all ADA in all connected wallets. Note: the actual code - likely a smart contract - calculating voting power will be delivered in M4)
・The verified VCs do not contain Personal Identifiable Information
ms.report:
Hello Reviewers, here is the M3 proof of achievement:
General explanation video of M3 tasks: A 13min video covering all our milestone outputs: https://youtu.be/79Igc1TlvI4 
Open-source code: In regards to the code, you can find it here: https://github.com/incubiq/vote_with_did/tree/main ; it supports all the minimal requirements defined in the M3 acceptance criteria. 
As explained in the video:
・A DID is issued as soon as a user creates a Digital Identity Wallet
・As soon as the DID is issued, the user can link their identity to external wallets, and prove their ownership (via a Sign Message)
・Proving ownership of a wallet will automatically create a Credential and a Proof of ownership, including basic data
・The user also has the possibility to request a Proof of Fund certificate, which can be used later for voting (voting eligibility, voting power, etc)

A backend has been developed, and will continue to evolve in M4 for the creation of ballot, voting settings, etc...
The browser extension App has been improved to include the UI for all features above, including validating ownership of other wallets, and a secure "automatic" authentication into the backend.
What next: We now move onto M4. Identus has been a source of many problems in the past few months. I really regret that Cardano is not offering a full stable sandbox env. I am building my own sandbox, but as we saw in M3, it can still break due to unforeseen external conditions, and create lots of work/trouble to fix. I feel that we may be 1 month late on the overall target (of end July) to finish the project, but I will try as much as possible to catch up. 
Thank you for your valued contributing in reviewing this milestone.
Eric

ms.report:
Hello Reviewers, here is the M4 proof of achievement:
General explanation video of M4 tasks: A 23min video covering all our milestone outputs: https://youtu.be/vBzfF3m3hwQ
Open-source code: In regards to the code, you can find it here: https://github.com/incubiq/vote_with_did/tree/main ; it supports all the minimal requirements defined in the M4 acceptance criteria. 
As explained in the video, we have, among others:
・Backend code for Ballot Creation, Voter Registration, Casting Votes, Tallying Votes.
・On-chain storage of encrypted poll votes and metadata
・A working WebApp UI for creating Polls / votes
・Delivery of a working WebApp UI for voting
・Delivery of VCs and Proof for eligibility to vote (user can register during registration period)
・Delivery of VCs and Proof for proof that a user has cast a vote 
・All end-user demos in the video

The full project has now been delivered, at least for the minimum requirement. There has been changes of design from what was planned 1 year ago, but overall, I am satisfied that we have a nice working solution, making extensive use of Digital Identity and Verifiable Credentials, as well as issuance of Proof. We also make the most of immutability and encryption to store votes directly on Cardano. As a result, the user can vote fully anonymously, and with the certainty that their vote have been cast. It took a little bit longer than initially planned, but I think what is important is to have delivered the project (alone!) within 1 year.
What next: Packaging and final Demo (still on Cardano Testnet preview) 
Thank you for your valued contributing in reviewing this milestone.
Eric
